official: 府中市議会議員及び府中市長の選挙における選挙運動の公費負担に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会市長提出議案

name: 選挙ビラ・ポスターの公費負担上限を引き上げる
summary: 現在、市が公費で負担する選挙ビラの作成費は、1枚当たり7.73円が上限です。議案では上限を8.38円にし、ポスター作成費の算定式に使う係数も541.31円から586.88円に改めます。
changes: ビラ1枚当たりの公費負担上限を7.73円から8.38円に引き上げる
ポスター1枚当たりの公費負担額の算定式の係数を541.31円から586.88円に改める
who: 府中市議会議員選挙・府中市長選挙の候補者
選挙ビラやポスターを作成する事業者
why: 公職選挙法施行令の一部改正に伴う改正のためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Raises public expense limits for election leaflets and posters
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Public Expense Coverage for Election Campaigns in Elections for Fuchu City Assembly Members and Fuchu City Mayor
en.summary: At present, the city covers the cost of producing election leaflets with public funds, up to ¥7.73 per leaflet. The bill raises the limit to ¥8.38 and changes the coefficient used in the formula for calculating poster production costs from ¥541.31 to ¥586.88.
changes: Raises the public expense limit per leaflet from ¥7.73 to ¥8.38
Changes the coefficient in the formula for calculating public expenses per poster from ¥541.31 to ¥586.88
who: Candidates in elections for Fuchu City Assembly members and Fuchu City mayor
Businesses that produce election leaflets and posters
en.why: The city says the amendment is being made in response to a partial amendment to the Order for Enforcement of the Public Offices Election Act.
